pairs.target: dào dìsìshíèr tiān zǎoshàng , tǎ wéi yǐjīng bǎ cèliáng biǎo de biānjiǎo mō ruǎn le .
pairs.english: By the morning of the forty-second day, Tavi had worn the corners of the measurement sheet soft with handling.
pairs.hanzi: 到第四十二天早上，塔维已经把测量表的边角摸软了。

pairs.target: tā zài dìsānshíjiǔ tiān hé dìsì shítiān gè liàn guò yícì .
pairs.english: He had practised once each on the thirty-ninth and fortieth days.
pairs.hanzi: 他在第三十九天和第四十天各练过一次。

pairs.target: dìyīcì huàn le jiàzi , dúcuò le yìbiān de qǐdiǎn , xìnghǎo hái méi bǎshǒu fàngshàngqù ;
pairs.english: The first time, with a different frame, he misread one side's starting point; fortunately he had not put his hands on yet.
pairs.hanzi: 第一次换了架子，读错了一边的起点，幸好还没把手放上去；

pairs.target: dìèrcì dú duì le , xiǎofú biànhuà yě tíngzhù le .
pairs.english: The second time he read correctly, and the small change held steady too.
pairs.hanzi: 第二次读对了，小幅变化也停住了。

pairs.target: zuótiān wéi lǎoshī bùxǔ tāmen jiāliàn , tā biàn zuòzài chuāng biān , bǎ jǐgè zǒng xiě wāi de shùzì xiě mǎn yìzhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: Yesterday Instructor Vey had forbidden extra practice, so he sat by the window and filled a sheet with the numerals he kept writing crookedly.
pairs.hanzi: 昨天维老师不许他们加练，他便坐在窗边，把几个总写歪的数字写满一张纸。

pairs.target: xiànzài , nà zhāng zhǐ zhé zài chuángtóu . tā dài jìn kǎo shì de zhǐyǒu chǐ , bǐ hé gānjìng de shǒu .
pairs.english: Now that sheet lay folded at his bedside. All he brought into the examination room was a ruler, a pen and clean hands.
pairs.hanzi: 现在，那张纸折在床头。他带进考室的只有尺、笔和干净的手。

pairs.target: ménwài pái zhe sìzhāng dèngzǐ . luò héng zuòzài zuì lǐmiàn , bǎ chǐ shù zài xī shàng , zhǐjiān yánzhe chǐ biān láihuí zǒu .
pairs.english: Four stools stood outside the door. Lohen sat furthest in, his ruler upright on his knee, a fingertip running back and forth along its edge.
pairs.hanzi: 门外排着四张凳子。洛衡坐在最里面，把尺竖在膝上，指尖沿着尺边来回走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng zuòxià , tā biàn bǎ chǐ fàng píng le . " bié wèn wǒ jǐn bu jǐnzhāng . "
pairs.english: As soon as Tavi sat down, he laid the ruler flat. “Don't ask if I'm nervous.”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维刚坐下，他便把尺放平了。
“别问我紧不紧张。”

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎng wèn xiānjìn qù de shì shuí . " " mǐlā . "
pairs.english: “I wanted to ask who went in first.” “Mira.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我想问先进去的是谁。”
“米拉。”

pairs.target: gé zhe mén , tīngdéjiàn yǐ jiǎo tuōdòng . liǎng rén dōu búzài shuōhuà .
pairs.english: They could hear chair legs scraping through the door. Neither spoke again.
pairs.hanzi: 隔着门，听得见椅脚拖动。两人都不再说话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe dìshàng yíkuài diào qī de dìfāng , juéde lǐmiàn bān le tài duōcì yǐzi ;
pairs.english: Tavi stared at a patch of peeling paint on the floor, feeling that the chairs inside had moved far too many times.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯着地上一块掉漆的地方，觉得里面搬了太多次椅子；

pairs.target: děng mén zhōngyú kāi le , mǐlā chūlái , xiùkǒu juàn dé yìbiān gāo yìbiān dī .
pairs.english: When the door finally opened, Mira came out with one sleeve rolled higher than the other.
pairs.hanzi: 等门终于开了，米拉出来，袖口卷得一边高一边低。

pairs.target: tā zǒu dào shuǐpén biān xǐshǒu , méi xiàng wǎngcháng nàyàng lìkè shuōhuà .
pairs.english: She went to wash her hands at the basin without speaking immediately as she usually did.
pairs.hanzi: 她走到水盆边洗手，没像往常那样立刻说话。

pairs.target: luò héng zhàn qǐlái , wèn : " zěnyàng ? " " jìnqù jiù zhīdào le . "
pairs.english: Lohen stood and asked, “How was it?” “You'll know once you're in.”
pairs.hanzi:
洛衡站起来，问：“怎样？”
“进去就知道了。”

pairs.target: tā shuǎidiào shǒushàng de shuǐ , chōng tāmen zuò le gè hěn nánkàn de xiàoliǎn .
pairs.english: She shook the water off her hands and gave them a truly dreadful smile.
pairs.hanzi: 她甩掉手上的水，冲他们做了个很难看的笑脸。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fǎnér qīngsōng le yìdiǎn , nà xiǎnrán búshì tā dǎsuàn ràng rén jìzhù de yàngzi .
pairs.english: That actually eased Tavi a little; it clearly was not how she wanted to be remembered.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维反而轻松了一点，那显然不是她打算让人记住的样子。

pairs.target: luò héng jìnqù yǐhòu , mǐlā zuò dào tǎ wéi pángbiān . tā xiǎng wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu zuòchéng , yòu pà dédào yígè xiànzài yòngbúshàng de dáàn .
pairs.english: After Lohen went in, Mira sat beside Tavi. He wanted to ask if she had succeeded, but feared an answer he could not use just now.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡进去以后，米拉坐到塔维旁边。他想问她有没有做成，又怕得到一个现在用不上的答案。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tā juàn dào zhǒu shàng de xiùzǐ wǎngxiàlā le yìdiǎn . " tàijǐn le . nǐ gāngcái yìzhí zài chě . "
pairs.english: She tugged his rolled sleeve a little down from his elbow. “Too tight. You kept pulling at it.”
pairs.hanzi:
她把他卷到肘上的袖子往下拉了一点。
“太紧了。你刚才一直在扯。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi sōngkāi bù , gēbo shàng liú zhe yídào hóng yìn . tāmen zuò zhe , shuí yě méi cāi lǐmiàn de tí .
pairs.english: Tavi loosened the cloth, leaving a red mark on his arm. They sat without guessing what the questions inside might be.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维松开布，胳膊上留着一道红印。他们坐着，谁也没猜里面的题。

pairs.target: lún dào tǎ wéi shí , tàiyáng yǐjīng zhào dào le ménkǎn .
pairs.english: By Tavi's turn, sunlight had reached the threshold.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到塔维时，太阳已经照到了门槛。

pairs.target: kǎo shì jiùshì píngshí shàngkè de nà jiān , qiánpái zhuōzi bìng zài yìqǐ , hòumiàn fàng zhe qīngshuǐ hé cābù .
pairs.english: The examination room was their usual classroom. The front tables had been pushed together, with clean water and wiping cloths behind them.
pairs.hanzi: 考室就是平时上课的那间，前排桌子并在一起，后面放着清水和擦布。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zuòzài yícè , jiǎn lǎoshī zài lìngyícè jì biǎo .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey sat on one side, while Instructor Jian recorded on the other.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师坐在一侧，简老师在另一侧记表。

pairs.target: chuāng kāi le yìtiáo fèng , méiyǒu nàzhǒng gùshì lǐ juédìng rén mìngyùn de gāo yǐzi . kě tǎ wéi háishì chàdiǎn bǎ chǐ luò zài ménwài .
pairs.english: The window was open a crack; there were none of those high chairs from stories where people's fates were decided. Yet Tavi still almost left his ruler outside.
pairs.hanzi:
窗开了一条缝，没有那种故事里决定人命运的高椅子。
可塔维还是差点把尺落在门外。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng fàng zhe liǎnggēn tóngyàng cháng de gāngtiáo .
pairs.english: Two steel strips of the same length lay on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上放着两根同样长的钢条。

pairs.target: jiàzi de cháoxiàng gēn tā shàngcì yòng de xiāngfǎn , xiǎo tóngkuài què réng guà zài néng kànqīng de wèizhì .
pairs.english: The frame faced the opposite way to the last one he had used, though the small copper weights still hung where he could see them clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 架子的朝向跟他上次用的相反，小铜块却仍挂在能看清的位置。

pairs.target: pángbiān yǒu chǐcùn jìlù , yào tā zìjǐ héduì ; liǎnggēn gāngtiáo dōu méiyǒu mó guò nàzhǒng néng liúxià biànhuà de jiēchùmiàn .
pairs.english: The dimensions were recorded beside it for him to check himself. Neither steel strip had the ground contact surfaces that could retain a change.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边有尺寸记录，要他自己核对；两根钢条都没有磨过那种能留下变化的接触面。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī ràng tā xiān bǎ búyòng de dōngxī fàngkāi , shuōmíng zìjǐ zhǔnbèi zuò shénme .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey asked him to put aside anything he did not need and explain what he intended to do.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师让他先把不用的东西放开，说明自己准备做什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō yào xiān liáng , zài kàn méiyǒu jiè xìng shí de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Tavi said he would measure first, then check the positions without property borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说要先量，再看没有借性时的位置。

pairs.target: tā bào le chángdù hé kuāndù , liáng dào hòudù shí tíng le yíxià , bǎ chǐ nuó dào liàng chù .
pairs.english: He read out the length and width, paused at the thickness, and moved the ruler into better light.
pairs.hanzi: 他报了长度和宽度，量到厚度时停了一下，把尺挪到亮处。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī méiyǒu cuī , zhī zài biǎo biān huà le gè duǎn jìhào .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian did not hurry him, only made a short mark in the margin of the form.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师没有催，只在表边画了个短记号。

pairs.target: dìyībiàn jìlù yǒu gè shùzì xiě fǎn le . tǎ wéi ná bǐhuà diào , zhòngxiě , shǒuxīn yǐjīng chū le hàn .
pairs.english: He wrote one numeral backwards on his first record. Tavi crossed it out and rewrote it; his palms were sweating already.
pairs.hanzi: 第一遍记录有个数字写反了。塔维拿笔划掉，重写，手心已经出了汗。

pairs.target: " kěyǐ cā . " wéi lǎoshī shuō . tā cāgān shǒu , yě bǎ gāngtiáo jiēchù chù cāgān .
pairs.english: “You can wipe them,” Instructor Vey said. He dried his hands and the steel strips' contact areas as well.
pairs.hanzi:
“可以擦。”维老师说。
他擦干手，也把钢条接触处擦干。

pairs.target: gāngcái zài ménwài xiǎng guò de nàxiē dàhuà , yíjù dōu bú shèng le .
pairs.english: Not a word remained of the grand things he had thought of saying outside.
pairs.hanzi: 刚才在门外想过的那些大话，一句都不剩了。

pairs.target: tā zhī shuō zìjǐ yào ràng zuǒbiān de tóngkuài dī yìdiǎn , zài huà hǎo de liǎngdào xiàn zhījiān tíngzhù , ránhòu jiéshù .
pairs.english: He only said he wanted to lower the left-hand weight a little, hold it between two drawn lines, then end the exchange.
pairs.hanzi: 他只说自己要让左边的铜块低一点，在画好的两道线之间停住，然后结束。

pairs.target: " wèizhì shì nǐ xuǎn de ? " " shì . bǐ wǒ shàngcì liàn de hái xiǎo yìdiǎn . "
pairs.english: “Did you choose the position?” “Yes. A little smaller than I practised last time.”
pairs.hanzi:
“位置是你选的？”
“是。比我上次练的还小一点。”

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī kàn le yìyǎn liǎngbiān de xiàn , ràng tā kāishǐ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey looked at the lines on both sides and told him to begin.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师看了一眼两边的线，让他开始。

pairs.target: liǎngzhīshǒu dāshàngqù yǐhòu , tǎ wéi xiān gǎnjué dào liáng , suíhòu cái zhǎodào shúxī de nà yìdiǎn bùtóng .
pairs.english: After placing both hands on the strips, Tavi first felt coolness, then found that familiar hint of difference.
pairs.hanzi: 两只手搭上去以后，塔维先感觉到凉，随后才找到熟悉的那一点不同。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān mànmàn wǎng xià , yòubiān xiāngyìng dì táiqǐ lái . tā xiǎng kànqīng zuǒbiān shìbushì guò xiàn , tóu bú zìjué dì wǎngqián còu .
pairs.english: The left side slowly lowered while the right rose in response. He wanted a clear view of whether the left had crossed its line, and unconsciously leaned his head forward.
pairs.hanzi: 左边慢慢往下，右边相应地抬起来。他想看清左边是不是过线，头不自觉地往前凑。

pairs.target: " zuò wěn . " jiǎn lǎoshī shuō . tǎ wéi bǎ jiǎo chóngxīn cǎi shí .
pairs.english: “Sit steady,” Instructor Jian said. Tavi planted his feet firmly again.
pairs.hanzi:
“坐稳。”简老师说。
塔维把脚重新踩实。

pairs.target: tóngkuài huàng le yíxià , méiyǒu pèngshàng xiànwèi mùkuài .
pairs.english: The weight swayed once without touching the wooden stop.
pairs.hanzi: 铜块晃了一下，没有碰上限位木块。

pairs.target: tā děng nà yìdiǎn huàngdòng guòqù , tīngjiàn wéi lǎoshī bàochū wèizhì , biàn sōngkāi le shǒu . liǎngbiān tuìhuí yuánchù .
pairs.english: He waited for that slight sway to pass, heard Instructor Vey read out the position, then released his hands. Both sides returned to their original positions.
pairs.hanzi:
他等那一点晃动过去，听见维老师报出位置，便松开了手。
两边退回原处。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu lìkè qù kàn lǎoshī de liǎn , xiān bǎ jìlù bǔ shàng .
pairs.english: Instead of looking at the teachers' faces immediately, he first completed the record.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有立刻去看老师的脸，先把记录补上。

pairs.target: bǐjiān zài zhǐ shàng tíng le yíshùn , tā cái fāxiànzìjǐ de shǒu méiyǒu má , jǐnbēng de jiānbǎng què suān le .
pairs.english: His pen paused on the paper for a moment. Only then did he notice that his hands were not numb, but his tense shoulders ached.
pairs.hanzi: 笔尖在纸上停了一瞬，他才发现自己的手没有麻，紧绷的肩膀却酸了。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī ràng tā xiūxi , wèn le jǐchù jìlù , cái huàn le tóngkuài de guà wèi , ràng tā chóngxīn dúshù , zài zuò yícì .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey gave him a rest and asked about several entries, then changed the weights' hanging positions and had him read the scale again and repeat the attempt.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师让他休息，问了几处记录，才换了铜块的挂位，让他重新读数，再做一次。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā méiyǒu wǎngqián tànshēn , liǎngbiān de biànhuà gèng xiǎo , tíng de wèizhì yě bùrú tóu yícì qízhěng , dàn réng zài tā shìxiān xuǎn de fànwéi lǐ .
pairs.english: This time he did not lean forward. The changes on both sides were smaller, and the stopping positions less neat than on the first attempt, but still within his chosen range.
pairs.hanzi: 这回他没有往前探身，两边的变化更小，停的位置也不如头一次齐整，但仍在他事先选的范围里。

pairs.target: zuò wán yǐhòu , jiǎn lǎoshī bǎ biǎo zhuǎnguò lái , zhǐ gěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: Afterward, Instructor Jian turned the form around and pointed for him to look.
pairs.hanzi: 做完以后，简老师把表转过来，指给他看。

pairs.target: " zhè chù shì nǐ gǎi de shù . pángbiān bǔ yígè yuánlái dú de wèizhì , biérén cáinéng zhīdào nǐ wèishénme gǎi . "
pairs.english: “This is the number you changed. Add the original reading position beside it, so someone else can tell why you changed it.”
pairs.hanzi: “这处是你改的数。旁边补一个原来读的位置，别人才能知道你为什么改。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàozhe bǔ le . wéi lǎoshī zài xiàmiàn xiě le liǎngháng zì , děng mò gān le yìdiǎn , cái ràng tā kàn .
pairs.english: Tavi added it as instructed. Instructor Vey wrote two lines below, waited for the ink to dry a little, then let him look.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维照着补了。维老师在下面写了两行字，等墨干了一点，才让他看。

pairs.target: " jīchǔ cāozuò zhè yíxiàng , tōngguò . nǐ xuǎn de fúdù xiǎo , liǎngcì dōu jiéshù dé qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: “Basic operation: passed. You chose a small change and ended it clearly both times.”
pairs.hanzi: “基础操作这一项，通过。你选的幅度小，两次都结束得清楚。

pairs.target: dúshù hé shūxiě hái dé liàn , huàn jiàzi shí yóuqí bùnéng jí . "
pairs.english: “Your readings and writing still need practice. Especially with a different frame, you must not rush.”
pairs.hanzi: 读数和书写还得练，换架子时尤其不能急。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān kànjiàn de shì " tōngguò " liǎnggè zì . pángbiān nàxiē zì tā dú dé màn , lǎoshī biàn děng zhe , méiyǒu bǎ biǎo shōuhuí qù .
pairs.english: The first thing Tavi saw was the word “passed.” He read the words beside it slowly; his teacher waited without taking the form away.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先看见的是“通过”两个字。旁边那些字他读得慢，老师便等着，没有把表收回去。

pairs.target: tā dúwán , wèn : " nà wǒ néng liúxià le ? "
pairs.english: After reading, he asked, “Then can I stay?”
pairs.hanzi: 他读完，问：“那我能留下了？”

pairs.target: " zhè shì cāozuò jiéguǒ , búshì zhěngfèn juédìng . nǐ de tú hé zhè jǐzhōu de jìlù jīntiān yìqǐ hé wán ,
pairs.english: “This is the practical result, not the whole decision. Your drawing and these weeks' records will all be checked today.”
pairs.hanzi: “这是操作结果，不是整份决定。你的图和这几周的记录今天一起核完，

pairs.target: míngzǎo gěi nǐ dáfù , yě huì bǎ zhèngshì zīzhù de tiáokuǎn zài jiǎng yíbiàn .
pairs.english: “You will have an answer tomorrow morning, and the full funding terms will be explained again.”
pairs.hanzi: 明早给你答复，也会把正式资助的条款再讲一遍。

pairs.target: jīnwǎn zhàocháng chīfàn , huí qǐnshì , búyòng děng zài zhèlǐ . "
pairs.english: “Eat and return to your room as usual tonight. No need to wait here.”
pairs.hanzi: 今晚照常吃饭、回寝室，不用等在这里。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé hěn zhíjiē . tǎ wéi diǎndiǎntóu , xīnlǐ kōng chūlái de dìfāng yòu bèi tián huíqù yìdiǎn , què méiyǒu quán tiánmǎn .
pairs.english: She spoke very directly. Tavi nodded; some of the space that had opened inside him filled again, though not completely.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得很直接。塔维点点头，心里空出来的地方又被填回去一点，却没有全填满。

pairs.target: chūménshí , mǐlā hé luò héng hái zuòzài dèngzǐ shàng .
pairs.english: When he came out, Mira and Lohen were still sitting on the stools.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，米拉和洛衡还坐在凳子上。

pairs.target: mǐlā kàn tā liǎngshǒukōngkōng , wǎng mén lǐ zhǐ le zhǐ . tā zhè cái zhéhuíqù , bǎ chǐ ná shàng .
pairs.english: Seeing his empty hands, Mira pointed back into the room. Only then did he go back for his ruler.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看他两手空空，往门里指了指。他这才折回去，把尺拿上。

pairs.target: " guò le . " tā shuō . " chǐ chàdiǎn méi guò . " luò héng shuō .
pairs.english: “Passed,” he said. “The ruler nearly didn't,” Lohen said.
pairs.hanzi:
“过了。”他说。
“尺差点没过。”洛衡说。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiào dé zhípāi xīgài . tǎ wéi yě xiào qǐlái , xiào wán cái fāxiànzìjǐ hái zhàn zhe .
pairs.english: Mira laughed so hard she slapped her knee. Tavi laughed too; only afterward did he realize he was still standing.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉笑得直拍膝盖。塔维也笑起来，笑完才发现自己还站着。

pairs.target: yuànzi lǐ de wǔfàn zhōngxiǎng le .
pairs.english: The lunch bell rang in the courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 院子里的午饭钟响了。

pairs.target: mǐlā yǐjīng ràngkāi bànzhāng dèngzǐ , jiàn tā bú zuò , yòu zhàn qǐlái , wèn yào buyào qù chī miàn .
pairs.english: Mira had made room for him on half her stool. Seeing he did not sit, she got up again and asked if he wanted noodles.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉已经让开半张凳子，见他不坐，又站起来，问要不要去吃面。

pairs.target: luò héng shuō jīntiān shì dòu fàn , búshì miàn , tā biàn shuō nà jiù qù chī dòu fàn , fǎnzhèng xiànzài chī shénme dōuxíng .
pairs.english: Lohen said today was bean rice, not noodles. She said they would have bean rice then; anything would do just now.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡说今天是豆饭，不是面，她便说那就去吃豆饭，反正现在吃什么都行。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēnzhe tāmen xià le táijiē . dào yuàn ménkǒu , tā hūrán yǒu le wèikǒu ,
pairs.english: Tavi followed them down the steps. At the courtyard gate, he suddenly found his appetite.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟着他们下了台阶。到院门口，他忽然有了胃口，

pairs.target: zǎoshàng miǎnqiǎng yànxiàqù de nà bànkuài bǐng , xiàngshì hěnjiǔyǐqián de shì le .
pairs.english: That half flatbread he had forced down in the morning felt like something from a long time ago.
pairs.hanzi: 早上勉强咽下去的那半块饼，像是很久以前的事了。
